title: Peloton Recovery-Ride Deficit
dataSources: Strava API activities (`strava:activity`), Garmin Connect (`garmin:activity`), Fitbit Web API (`fitbit:activity`), Peloton workout history (`peloton:workout`), Zwift ride exports (`zwift:activity`).
app: Strava / Garmin Connect / Fitbit / Peloton / Zwift APIs and webhooks via Splunk HEC scripted inputs; GPX/FIT/CSV activity exports ingested as file inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=peloton:workout
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats count as total_classes, sum(eval(class_type="Recovery Ride")) as recovery_classes by athlete _time
| eval recovery_pct=round(100*recovery_classes/total_classes,1)
| where total_classes>=8 AND recovery_pct<5
| sort recovery_pct
description: Calculates how often your Peloton month includes actual recovery rides instead of only hard sessions and power workouts.
value: Structured rest is easy to skip in app-based training because the fun classes are usually the hardest ones; this keeps your month honest.
implementation: Capture Peloton class metadata including class type; schedule monthly and nudge yourself when recovery work disappears from the mix.
visualization: Monthly table of class counts and recovery-ride percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It compares when your bike workouts turn into all hard efforts and almost no easy recovery rides.
